Title: General availability: Conditional Access feature integration with AKS

Body.Content:
Azure Active Directory (AAD) uses the Conditional Access feature to make decisions and enforce organizational policies. At their simplest, Conditional Access policies are if-then statements. For example, in order to access a resource, you must complete an action e.g. multi-factor authentication.

By using Conditional Access policies, you can apply the right access controls when needed to keep your AKS resources secure and stay out of your user's way when not needed.

Learn more.
